name: murmur
description: Murmur — monorepo: apps/web (React, roda no host) + apps/api (FastAPI, roda em Docker). Notas pessoais com gravação de áudio, transcrição via faster-whisper e análise via camada LLM plugável.

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U murmur -d murmur
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: docker compose exec api alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:downgrade: docker compose exec api alembic downgrade -1
